priorityList: Cast Haunt as your top priority to maintain its debuff on the target.
Maintain Agony on the target, refreshing it when it is in the refreshable window.
Maintain Wither on the target, refreshing it when it is in the refreshable window.
Cast Dark Harvest if your Agony and Wither durations are healthy.
Summon Darkglare as your primary offensive cooldown.
Cast Malevolence, ideally while Darkglare is active.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities while Darkglare is active.
Spend Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction if you have 5 shards to prevent capping.
Cast Unstable Affliction if Darkglare or Malevolence is active, or if you have Shard Instability or Cascading Calamity procs.
Use Malefic Grasp when you have Nightfall procs or if Darkglare is about to expire.
Use Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt if you have Nightfall procs and Malefic Grasp is not available.
Use Malefic Grasp as your primary filler spell.
In the final seconds of a fight, spend remaining Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction.
In the final seconds of a fight, use any remaining Nightfall procs on Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt.
